claims.claim: UK used Lens are available in our shop

risks.risk: Lens may be damaged internally (haze/fungus/scratches) or optics may be poor even if the outside looks fine.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video through the front element and rear element under light (and a close-up of the glass), plus a test shot showing sharpness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: optics not guaranteed (assume needs inspection; treat as not fully reliable).

risks.risk: Autofocus/zoom may not work smoothly (sticking, grinding, or AF failure).
risks.proof: Video of zooming from 18mm to 55mm and a camera AF test (focus lock attempt) showing it hunts/locks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not guaranteed to autofocus/zoom properly.

risks.risk: Mount/contacts may be worn or misaligned, causing poor fit or electrical issues with the camera.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens mount contacts and the bayonet area, plus a fit check on the camera body (photo of it mounted).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: mount/contacts may be faulty (assume reduced compatibility).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incorrect caps (front/rear caps) affecting usability and resale.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out (front cap, rear cap, hood if any, paperwork).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may be missing some accessories.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the lens glass (front and rear) showing any fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a short video: zoom ring movement from 18mm to 55mm (smoothness) and focus/AF attempt on a camera body.
Send a close-up of the mount contacts/bayonet and a photo of the lens mounted on the camera.
List what is included: front cap, rear cap, hood, and any other accessories.
response.reason: The lens type is readable (Canon EFS 18-55mm), but key condition factors that determine value in Rivers (optics quality, AF/zoom function, mount condition, and included accessories) are not verifiable from these photos alone.
